description:
Subject: Project Overview – EcoTracker  

I’m pleased to share details about our new initiative, **EcoTracker**, authored by **Jane Doe**. This platform is designed to track personal carbon footprints and to provide actionable sustainability suggestions. The project was created on **2024‑03‑01**, and we have progressed to **version 3** of the software.
